title: Reduce the main rate writing-down allowance and increase the main rate first-year allowance
text:
This measure reduces the main rate of writing-down allowances to 12% from:

 • 1 April 2027 for Corporation Tax

 • 6 April 2027 for Income Tax

 It also increases the rate of the main rate first-year allowance from 40% to 50% for expenditure incurred on or after 1 January 2027.
